cc:Work.dc:title: Shelf - SBCMicroRack
cc:Work.dc:description:
Stackable rackable racks for SBC Pi-Style Computers
Created with Boxes.py (https://boxes.hackerspace-bamberg.de/) Command line: boxes SBCMicroRack --sbcs 2 --x 60 --y 90 --thickness 3 --labels 1 --reference 0 Command line short: boxes SBCMicroRack --sbcs --x --y --reference
